title: Membership tests
statement: In CPython 3.13, which statements about the in operator are true? Pick every one that applies.
choices: x in some_set is O(1) on average, because it looks x up by its hash.
1.0 in {1} is False, because 1.0 and 1 are different types.
10**9 in range(10**12) answers in constant time, without iterating over the range.
k in some_dict searches the dict's values as well as its keys.
